summary: The training and rollout guide chapter complies with the plan, research brief, and context governance. It structures role-specific training modules, sandbox workflow simulations, phased multi-site deployment protocols, and operational user adoption measurement. All required workflow roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions, evaluation criteria, and labeled illustrative examples are properly integrated. Citations accurately reflect the ISO/IAF APG external provider guidance and ICC module capabilities (including human-in-the-loop review of AI suggestions and pending supplier portal features). Unassigned FAQ content is correctly omitted.

glossary.definition: An intensive, temporary post-deployment operational support phase where technical and process specialists provide immediate assistance on-site or on-call to resolve user friction and procedural roadblocks.
